question: How many total medals did India win at the International Shooting Sport Federation ( ISSF ) Rifle / Pistol world cup 2023 held in Bhopal?
solution:
The correct answer is __**8**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• India secured a total of **8 medals** at the International Shooting Sport Federation (ISSF) Rifle/Pistol World Cup 2023 held in Bhopal.
 
• The medal tally included **4 golds, 3 silvers, and 1 bronze**, showcasing India's strong performance in shooting sports.
 
• This event was held in **Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, India**, and marked a significant milestone for Indian shooting athletes.
 
• India finished at the **top of the medal tally**, outperforming other participating nations.
 
• The event was organized by the **ISSF**, which governs international shooting competitions worldwide.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] ** Additional Information__**

 
• **ISSF World Cup:**

 
 
• The ISSF World Cup is an annual series of shooting competitions organized by the International Shooting Sport Federation.
 
• It features events in rifle, pistol, and shotgun shooting disciplines.
 
• The competition serves as a platform for shooters to earn Olympic quotas and rankings.
 
 
 
• **India’s Rising Dominance in Shooting:**
 
 
• India has emerged as a strong contender in shooting sports over the last decade, consistently performing well in ISSF events.
 
• The nation's shooting talent has been nurtured through initiatives like the **Target Olympic Podium Scheme (TOPS)** and the Khelo India program.
 
 
 
• **Key Indian Medalists:**
 
 
• Indian shooters such as **Divya TS, Sarabjot Singh, and Rhythm Sangwan** were among the standout performers in the Bhopal ISSF World Cup.
 
• They contributed significantly to India’s overall medal haul, earning both individual and team medals.
 
 
 
• **Bhopal as the Host City:**
 
 
• The ISSF World Cup 2023 was hosted in Bhopal at the **MP State Shooting Academy**, a world-class facility for shooting sports.
 
• The event witnessed participation from over 30 countries, highlighting India’s capability to organize international competitions.
